description: Covers official recalls for products, food, medicines, devices and vehicles by name, VIN, year/make/model or items list. Kids covers child gear. For pet food, see Pets. US, UK, Canada and EU coverage varies. An empty result does not prove safety. Not medical advice.

ages.description: For kids: children’s ages, used for safety guidance

category.description: product, food_drug, vehicle, kids or household. Omit to infer.

country.description: Country to check, US by default.

items.description: Up to six names. Set household for a mixed list.

limit.description: Vehicle: maximum notices to show, 6 by default.

offset.description: Vehicle: number of notices to skip.

query.description: Item, brand plus product, or year make and model. For example: crib, peanut butter or CPAP.

name: check_recalls
title: Recalls: products, food, vehicles
